session_roles.name: Strategic Oversight
session_roles.purpose: Provides senior strategic governance, supervises the Session Manager, protects advisory quality and resolves high-level process or strategic conflicts.

session_roles.name: Session Manager
session_roles.purpose: Manages meeting lifecycle, agenda, focus, specialist proposals and participant approval workflow under strategic oversight.

session_roles.name: Lead Advisor
session_roles.purpose: Leads advisory synthesis and integrates specialist recommendations.

session_roles.name: Session Secretary
session_roles.purpose: Maintains the structured meeting record, decisions, actions, risks, evidence and outputs.
